# BatteryIncluded Sylius Plugin – integration guide for AI agents

> Everything needed to add BatteryIncluded search, suggestions, category pages and recommendations to a Sylius 2 shop
> with `eiling-io/sylius-battery-included-plugin`. Follow the steps in order.
> Human-readable docs: https://sylius.batteryincluded.eiling.io/
> The plugin is built on the BatteryIncluded Symfony Bundle, its guide covers configuration, export and events:
> https://bundle.batteryincluded.eiling.io/llms-full.txt

## 0. Ask the user for

1. The collection name of every channel, always prefixed with `customer.` (e.g. `customer.my-shop`).
2. The API key of each collection. Store it in `.env.local`, a Symfony secret or the server environment, never in a
   committed file or the browser.
3. The channel codes of the shop (admin → Configuration → Channels).
4. Whether the collections may be fully replaced: `bi:export` deletes all documents that are not exported.

## 1. Install and enable

Plugin and bundle are only available as `dev-main`, the shop needs `"minimum-stability": "dev"` and
`"prefer-stable": true` in its `composer.json`.

```bash
composer require eiling-io/sylius-battery-included-plugin:dev-main
```

```php
// config/bundles.php, the bundle before the plugin
Batteryincluded\BatteryincludedBundle\BatteryincludedBundle::class => ['all' => true],
EilingIo\SyliusBatteryIncludedPlugin\EilingIoSyliusBatteryIncludedPlugin::class => ['all' => true],
```

```dotenv
# .env.local
BATTERYINCLUDED_COLLECTION=customer.my-shop
BATTERYINCLUDED_API_KEY=...
```

```yaml
# config/packages/_sylius.yaml
imports:
    - { resource: "@EilingIoSyliusBatteryIncludedPlugin/config/config.yaml" }
```

```yaml
# config/routes/eiling_io_batteryincluded.yaml, the routes get the prefix /{_locale}
eiling_io_sylius_battery_included_plugin:
    resource: "@EilingIoSyliusBatteryIncludedPlugin/config/routes.yaml"
```

```js
// assets/shop/entrypoint.js, then rebuild the assets (yarn build)
import '@vendor/eiling-io/sylius-battery-included-plugin/assets/shop/entrypoint.js';
```

Verify: `bin/console bi:status` exits with 0.

## 2. Several channels

Only needed with more than one channel. Each channel gets one collection of the bundle, channels without entry use
`default`. A collection can only be assigned to one channel.

```yaml
# config/packages/batteryincluded.yaml
batteryincluded:
    collections:
        ch:
            collection: '%env(BATTERYINCLUDED_COLLECTION_CH)%'
            api_key: '%env(BATTERYINCLUDED_API_KEY_CH)%'

eiling_io_sylius_battery_included:
    channels:
        FASHION_WEB: default
        FASHION_CH: ch
```

Without `channels` the products of the first enabled channel are exported into `default`.

## 3. Export

```bash
bin/console bi:export --dry-run   # serializes the products, nothing is sent
bin/console bi:export --force     # default collection
bin/console bi:export -c ch -f    # every further collection
bin/console bi:sync PRODUCT-5     # single product, id PRODUCT-<Sylius product id>
```

Only enabled products assigned to the channel are exported, as documents of type `PRODUCT`, the default locale of the
channel in `_PRODUCT` and every locale of the channel in `_PRODUCT_i18n` (`en-us`, `de-de`, …):
`name`, `description`, `ordernumber` (= product code), `price` and `instock` (first variant), `imageUrl`, `shopUrl`,
`rating`, `categories` (paths of the leaf taxons, `A > B`), `properties` (option values),
`manufacture` (attributes `cap_brand`, `t_shirt_brand`, `jeans_brand`, `dress_brand`). Translated: `name`,
`description`, `manufacture`, `shopUrl`, `categories`, `properties`.

Products are not synced automatically on save. Schedule `bi:export --force` (cron) or call the bundle's
`DocumentSynchronizer::syncByIds(['PRODUCT-5'], $collection, deleteMissing: true)` from a listener of the Sylius
product events.

## 4. Portal configuration

In the BatteryIncluded portal (https://sdk.batteryincluded.eiling.io/backend-configuration):

- Variable `locale`: `{"name": "locale", "default": "en-us", "root": ["_PRODUCT_i18n", "_CONTENT_i18n"]}`, the shop
  sends the locale of the URL (`de_DE` => `de-de`)
- Filterable: `_PRODUCT_i18n.<locale>.categories` and `.properties.*` of every locale, `_PRODUCT.price`
- Sortable: `_PRODUCT.price`, `_PRODUCT_i18n.<locale>.name`
- Searchable: `_PRODUCT_i18n.<locale>.name` and `.description`
- Suggest fields: `_PRODUCT.ordernumber` (hits are matched to Sylius products by the product code)
- Presets with the IDs `5ec20093-4d66-4ab7-80a3-632835e02c12` (homepage slider) and
  `0b2fdce1-0809-450c-a522-cef26ce5a283` (404 page, search without hits), or disable these sliders

## 4b. Optional: pages of the Sylius CMS plugin

If `Sylius\CmsPlugin\SyliusCmsPlugin` is enabled, its enabled and published pages of the channel are exported as
`CONTENT-<page id>` (`_CONTENT`: `code`, `title`, `teaser`, `content`, `url`, translations in `_CONTENT_i18n`) and
shown in the suggestions and above the products of the search page. Disable it with
`eiling_io_sylius_battery_included.cms_pages: false`. Portal: `type` filterable (the product search filters by
`type` = `PRODUCT`), `_CONTENT.title`, `_CONTENT.teaser`, `_CONTENT.content` searchable, `_CONTENT.title` and
`_CONTENT.code` as suggest fields.

## 5. What the shop gets

- `/{locale}/search?search=<q>` search page, parameters `filter[<field>]`, `filter[_PRODUCT.price][min|max]`, `sort`, `page`
- `/{locale}/searchAjax?search=<q>` suggestion overlay of the search box in the header
- Category pages (`sylius_shop_product_index`) filtered by `_PRODUCT_i18n.categories` with the path in the language of
  the URL
- Recommendations (`related`, `also`, `together`) on the product page, in the cart and the offcanvas cart
- Preset sliders on the homepage and the 404 page

## 6. Customizing

- Templates: override below `templates/bundles/EilingIoSyliusBatteryIncludedPlugin/shop/...`
- Twig hooks: `eiling_io_searchbox`, `eiling_io_product_recommendation`, `eiling_io_cart_recommendation`,
  `eiling_io_offcanvas_cart_recommendation`, `eiling_io_preset_slider`, `eiling_io_error404_products`; disable with
  `enabled: false` in `sylius_twig_hooks.hooks`
- Translations: domain `messages`, prefix `eiling_io_sylius_battery_included.`
- Fields: listener of `Batteryincluded\BatteryincludedBundle\Event\DocumentsEvent`. Select the documents by
  `$document instanceof ProductBaseDto && $document->getType() === 'PRODUCT'`, not by `$event->provider`: single
  syncs are sent without provider.
- Own document types: data provider of the bundle implementing `CollectionAwareDataProviderInterface` and
  `PartialDataProviderInterface`
- Replace the product export: decorate `eiling_io_sylius_battery_included.product_data_provider.<collection>`
- SDK services for the current channel: `EilingIo\SyliusBatteryIncludedPlugin\Factory\ServiceFactory`
  (`getBrowseService()`, `getSuggestService()`, `getRecommendationsService()`, …)

## 7. Verification checklist

- [ ] `bin/console bi:status` exits with 0 for every collection
- [ ] `bin/console bi:export --dry-run` lists `ProductDataProvider` with more than 0 documents
- [ ] `bin/console bi:export --force` succeeded for every collection
- [ ] `/<locale>/search?search=<term>` shows products in every language, the facets and sorting work
- [ ] Typing into the search box shows the suggestion overlay
- [ ] A category page shows products of the taxon
- [ ] The product page shows recommendations
- [ ] No API key in a committed file
